notes: All 21 source and 26 target ids are partitioned exactly once.

ἰδίᾳ is `unrepresented` because the ASV writes no *own* and the expressed αὐτῶν is what *their* answers to; rule 47 would give ἴδιος the possessive only where no such possessor stands, and rule 12 keeps the underdetermined variant from bearing on the status.
τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν splits, the ASV writing two words: the article keeps the determiner and the participle the nominal *dwellers* (rules 22 and 90).
τό before χωρίον is emptied by the attributive ἐκεῖνο (rule 38); τῇ before διαλέκτῳ by the expressed αὐτῶν (rule 20), so *in* stays with the noun.
ὥστε → *insomuch that* is one clause-introducer headed on the word carrying the sense (rules 40 and 61).
